in_sanskrit.name: Rachna
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Creating, Art, Craft

It is derived from the root word Rach, which means 'to create'. This name is rich in spiritual and artistic symbolism, representing the divine power of creation.
